a.lede: Apple is changing its App Tracking Transparency prompts in parts of Europe after competition regulators said the system favored Apple over third-party apps, giving developers more flexibility over how they ask users for tracking consent.
a.title: Apple will let EU apps use less-alarming tracking-consent screens

b.lede: Apple has developed an unexpected workaround to prevent the iPhone 18 Pro Max from being hit by shipping restrictions on big batteries. b.title: Apple’s clever software solution lets iPhone batteries skirt shipping limits
